cohort: 103 children diagnosed with acute lymphocytic leukemia (ALL) or acute myelogenous leukemia (AML) (cases) and 103 children hospitalized for non-cancer treatment (controls) in Rwanda.
finding: Children who experienced birth asphyxia or neonatal jaundice had a significantly increased risk of childhood leukemia.
mod_finding: 41.3% of the children in the study were born via C-section, but the abstract does not report a statistical association between mode of birth and childhood leukemia.
